title: Conjunctivitis
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: This is an inflammation of the conjunctivae and one of the most common causes of red eyes. The cause of conjunctivitis may be allergy, viral, or bacterial. Clinical features and treatment guideline depend on the type and cause of conjunctivitis.

runs.text: This is an inflammation of the conjunctivae and one of the most common causes of red eyes. The cause of conjunctivitis may be allergy, viral, or bacterial. Clinical features and treatment guideline depend on the type and cause of conjunctivitis.

blocks.text: If conjunctivitis is due to an infection, counsel on the importance of frequent hand washing, use separate linen, towels and wash towels and avoid direct contact with infected materials or individuals

blocks.text: Contacts lenses should not be worn in patients with conjunctivitis until the condition has resolved
